publishedfiledetails.description:
The city is burning. As ash falls, the survivors attempt to flee to a small military airfield on the other side of the river. It's a straight path down the main boulevard, but nothing is ever simple. Crashed cars, blazing fires, police barricades, and the city itself all stand in their way.

[i]Urban Flight[/i] is a four-map campaign that features interesting environments, dynamic pathways, and a unique multi-stage finale. It supports singleplayer, co-op, versus, survival, and scavenge gameplay.

[h1]Notes[/h1]
[b]TURN ON INSTRUCTOR HINTS![/b] This campaign uses the Instructor Hint system to explain important crescendo and finale event information. The Game Instructor can be enabled under Options > Multiplayer.

[h1]Scavenger Hunt[/h1]
To add an extra level of entertainment, the campaign features 10 minor easter eggs hidden throughout the environment. See if you can locate all of them. They are:

A pack of gnomes
A news-worthy drive-by
A gunshot suicide
A ridiculous notice
A cocaine habit
A shipment of beef
A floating upgrade
A BYOB workday
A spinning plate
A shipment of tank

Disclaimer: this is a new experiment of mine. I don't know how it will go - please don't immediately bash it if it doesn't work out because of conflicts & complexity; in my view, it could solve some issues I had with earlier system.


The new proposed manifest system.
Think of it as Particle Support 2.0, but don't worry - the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=373048945]OLD PARTICLES SUPPORT[/url] [u]isn't going anywhere[/u], and is compatible with this one / can be used together.
The idea is to allow for more non-conflicting particles, whether it's  "original replacement" effect or custom one used by model or script. You can now download separate laser sight mods, bilebomb, defibrillator, melee guns, because it defines more custom .pcf files for difference effects ( but mods must be specifically released for this system ).

FAQ:
[b][i]What mods do use it?[/i][/b]
- "Infinite Warfare" particles support uses it, which in turn, is used by Scream's Infinite Warfare weapon releases
- I plan to release "new" versions of some of my mods for this new system. Already available are: SkyBlue Laser Sight,
Deployable Tree, Divine Defi, Blue Tracers, etc.
- I created a collection [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1380974832]Mods compatible with Particles_Manifest system[/url]

[b][i]It conflicts with <some addon>![/i][/b]
I used to avoid using a manifest, but lately changed my mind, because, it's extremely rare for other mods to use it.
Some very few campaigns might use it - but they shouldn't anyway, as maps can use their own manifest, so if that's the case, they're doing it wrong.
Also, often some addon might have manifest included by misunderstanding/ignorance/error of author.

[b][i]- I get a bunch of errors like "couldn't find particles/defi.pcf" every time a map loads![/i][/b]
- Inevitably, this is the sole issue with this. It's normal. BUT, if that annoys you, you can download a fix (you need to unpack it to your game) https://www.dropbox.com/sh/iskodx1mag3vnpp/AAB4xxI0IAneinw2-RAc9oy3a?dl=0
Todo: I later may include the "fix" inside vpk itself so it can be extracted from there as an option

[code]
I will try to "collect" responses on which addons have manifest (conflict). But the only thing I will be able to do is suggest little guidance or (possibly )offer 'fixed' versions of conflicting addons. I can't force other authors to follow some rules, it's free world and it's noone's fault that things get released and conflict really.
[/code]

[code]Throughout my modding experience, especially since workshop happened, I've been trying to find some ways to allow more flexibility for users while trying to avoid conflicts while reasonable. But each time you tip the balance towards one side the other suffers. Sometimes the outcome is more complicated than advantages it yields. We'll see how this goes...[/code]

Development Paused Due to Real-Life Commitments - Feel Free to Modify and Redistribute the Source Code
[h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3022416274&searchtext=left+4+bots+2]We recommend trying Left 4 Bots 2 as an alternative[/url][/h1]
[h1][url=https://github.com/RogoShum/l4d2-Advanced-Bot-AI/releases] Previous version [/url][/h1]

[h1]Various Unique Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Optimized Bot combat awareness and improved teamwork capabilities. (See Bot Combat Skill Settings for details.)
[*]Bots can pick up throwable items and actively throw Molotovs when encountering a Tank.
[*]If a player has no pills or medkits, Bots will voluntarily offer their resources, whether it's pills, medkits, or throwables.
[*]Right-clicking a Bot while holding a throwable allows swapping throwables with the Bot.
[*]Bots can use defibrillators.
[*]Bots can use ammo upgrades.
[*]Prevents situations where Bots step on Spitter acid while reviving.
[*]On certain maps, Bots will help players find gas cans and bring them to the fuel machine.
[*]If a player is grabbed by a Smoker and the Bot cannot see the Smoker, the Bot will prioritize freeing the player by breaking the tongue.
[/list]

[h1]Bot Combat Skill Settings[/h1]
The current version has readjusted Bot combat behavior. They now better prioritize targets, protect themselves, and rescue players, with significantly improved teamwork.
There are five skill levels, with increasing improvements to vision range, aiming ability, reaction speed, success rate of shoving Special Infected, etc. The skill level does not affect Bot decision-making but only impacts their combat effectiveness against hordes, Special Infected, and focus-firing Tanks.

[table]
[tr]
[th]Level[/th]
[th]Description[/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]1[/td]
[td]Closest to vanilla combat ability but with better teamwork. Suitable for players who don't want increased difficulty but desire improved Bot decision-making. Ideal for Advanced mode players.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]2[/td]
[td]Stronger than vanilla, with improved vision range (can detect zombies at their sides) and faster reaction speed. Overall better performance, bordering on Expert mode.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]3[/td]
[td]Further improved vision range (can detect zombies behind them). Enhanced individual combat ability, with better self-preservation and damage output. Can handle Expert mode smoothly.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]4[/td]
[td]Begins to introduce cheaty/fun elements. Anti-Special Infected and damage output far exceed vanilla. Recommended for high-difficulty custom maps.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]5[/td]
[td]Single Bot's damage output is roughly equal to three average players combined. Can handle modes with increased Special Infected spawns.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[h1]Mod Configuration Menu[/h1]
Some features of this mod can be toggled via an hud menu. Open the chat (press Y) and type !botmenu to access it.
Alternatively, bind a key to +grenade1 (e.g., enter bind "j" "+grenade1" in the console) or bind a key to open the menu directly (e.g., bind "j" "say !botmenu").

[b]Note: The menu may not respond on dedicated servers—use commands instead.[/b]

Toggleable menu options (Incomplete):
[list]
[*]Bot skill level.
[*]Bot teleportation range when too far away.
[*]Toggle Bot gas can fetching in fuel missions.
[*]Toggle Bot throwable usage.
[*]Toggle Bot melee combat.
[*]Toggle Bot immunity to friendly fire.
[*]Toggle Bot auto-pathfinding.
[*]Toggle Bot teleport when stuck.
[*]Toggle Bot carrying resources (gas cans, propane tanks, etc.).
[*]Toggle Bot continuing to progress after player death.
[*]Toggle Bot defibrillator usage.
[*]Toggle Bot picking up and using Molotovs and pipe bombs.
[/list]

In a dedicated server only administrators can use menus and commands

[h1]This script is created to counter troll players who intentionally kill teammates.[/h1]
 - If someone shoots teammates, the victims will not take the damage but the attacker will take 2/3 of the damage.
 - The fire and explosion damage is not reflected.
 - If you use a script that adjusts the damage of friendly fire, this script may set the friendly fire damage to the default.
 - This script only works on your local server.
 - No action other than the add-on subscription is required to apply the script.
 - If you are alone (single play or all other players go idle), the reflection will be turned off automatically.
 - If there are multiple players, the reflection will be turned on automatically.

[h1]※ How to turn on/off the reflection for ONLY YOUR CHARACTER[/h1]
 - If you don’t want to reflect the friendly fire damage, chat "!FF" or "!ff" to turn off your reflection.
 - After this, you can get the friendly fire.
 - If you want to turn on the reflection, chat "!FF" or "!ff" again.
 - Anyone(even non-host players) can turn on/off the reflection protecting their characters in the same way.

This mod makes survivor's HP regenerate on a certain condition which you can edit to your taste


[h1][Features][/h1]
- You can set specific options like HP threshold, interval, regen value or type.
- You can set a variety of condtions like when on fire, standing still or seized by special infected
- Most of options and conditions can be set separately by survivor's life state(healthy or in black and white)
- You can set extra HP regen when using pain pills and adrenaline separately from main HP regen
- I've made some presets for people who don't like complicated setting or confused by lots of options


[h1][Instructions on commands][/h1]
- You can see all commands [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927658367]in here [/url]
- All commands are host-only and detected by typing to chat box
- The value of all commands will be saved automatically right after typed so you don't have to type repeatedly every time create a room 
(the path: ~\Left 4 Dead 2\left4dead2\ems\hpregen_hextomax\[command name].txt)
- The value of all commands must be integer
- By typing only the command you can see a brief description about it in game


[h1][Commands][/h1]
those use too many lines so [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927658367]GO TO HERE [/url]


[h1][Presets][/h1]
- You can see all commands of each preset [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2927658367]in here [/url]

[b]!hpregen_preset_default[/b] - all commands go back to default value

[b]!hpregen_preset_1[/b] - Modern Warfare like preset
HP regenerates by 10 every 3 seconds and regeneration will stop for 10 seconds when taking damage

[b]!hpregen_preset_2[/b] - Delayed effect of pain pills and adrenaline
No HP regeneration and the effect of pain pills and adrenaline appears over 5 seconds

[b]!hpregen_preset_3[/b] - Only to prevent very slow move when HP is 1
When HP is only 1 it will regenerate to 2

[b]!hpregen_preset_4[/b] - Slow heal when don't move
HP will regenerate by 5 every 4 seconds when the survivor is standing still 

[b]!hpregen_preset_5[/b] - Good thing I'm indestructible
HP regenerates by 100 every second


!!! This addon is server-side script. It means this will work only if you create a local server

Allow custom melee weapons to create many color trailing effects. This is only the base particle, it doesn't actually just give your existing weapon melee trail effects, it must be added to animation sequences (only useful for modders).

[h1] Available effect list:[/h1] 

weapon_melee_blue_trail

weapon_melee_yellow_laser
weapon_melee_pink_trail

weapon_melee_pink_trail_laser
weapon_melee_orange_trail

weapon_melee_purple_embers
weapon_melee_purple_laser
weapon_melee_white_trail
weapon_melee_white_embers
weapon_melee_white_laser
weapon_melee_black_trail
weapon_melee_neon_trail (fade from pink to blue)
weapon_melee_lava_trail (fade from yellow to red)
weapon_melee_icy_trail (fade from orange to blue)
weapon_melee_warp (simple refract trail)

[h1] Example:[/h1] 
$sequence "swing_e_w_layer" {
"anims\swing_e_w.smd"
activity "ACT_VM_HITLEFT" 1
[b]{ event AE_CL_CREATE_PARTICLE_EFFECT 2 "weapon_melee_blue_laser follow_attachment attach_blur" }[/b]
fadein 0
fadeout 0.2
fps 36 
}

The bolded text is what you needed to add, it will create the particle on frame 2 of the animation, effect name is weapon_melee_blue_laser, and it will be created at attachment named "attach_blur"

The attachment may need to be rotated to align with the blade so the beam effect can be angled correctly, otherwise it would look bad

After fighting their way North through ravenous hordes, Nick, Coach, Ellis, and Rochelle abandon their boat at a nearby dock due to a collapsed bridge.
With nowhere else to go, the survivors head inland in hopes of finding rescue.
Unbeknownst to them, the frostbite will be the least of their worries.

[strike]------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/strike]

Inspired by [url=https://www.roblox.com/games/3234050617/Left-2-Die-DISCONTINUED]Fuze Studios’ Left 2 Die[/url], Cold Front is a fresh, new custom campaign that takes the fight against the infected hordes up north to a colder climate.

Currently, Cold Front supports [b]Coop[/b], [b]Versus[/b], and most [b]Mutations[/b].
For more details on planned features and updates, click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3135451698/4039232337477238642/]here.[/url]
For the Gamemaps mirror, click [url=https://www.gamemaps.com/details/30655]here.[/url]
If you are hard of hearing and require subtitles, the accessibility patch can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3131460110]here.[/url]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/MMoM9JG.png[/img]
Cold Front features many new ideas and overhauls of established concepts found in the base game.
[list]
[*] 5 full-length maps, on par with the longest campaigns from the base game.
[*] Varied and interesting environments; Each map takes you through unique locations.
[*] A fresh new theme not often seen; Brace the storm before the horde.
[*] Fully customized talker scripts for brand new conversations and reactions.
[*] An interactable world: Various things around the map can actually be used!
[*] Dynamic finale; Influenced by your skills, you have multiple ways to escape.
[*] Enhanced storm mechanic - Just like Hard Rain, but more impactful.
[*] Custom soundtracks created specifically for this project by talented musicians.
[*] Hundreds of custom and unique Infected that match the campaign’s theme.
[*] Over 400 custom voicelines recorded by multiple skilled voice actors.
[*] Thorough balancing for all difficulties - You won’t need director tips, just follow the flow.
[*] Plenty of eastereggs and references to search for and discover.
[*] And lots more.[/list]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/fyMSncd.png[/img]

For legitimate bugs, report them [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/3135451698/4039232337477244815/]here[/url].


[b][u]The following mods may conflict with the campaign:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Custom populations (The campaign uses its own custom models and populations that will conflict.)
[*] 4+ players and Survivor Swaps (May break areas that require only the L4D2 survivors to be around.)
[*] Bill voice replacement mods (Will conflict with custom voicelines.)
[*] Survivor ragdoll mods (May crash the game when a survivor dies.)[/list]

It is recommended to play without these types of mods, even if they do not show up as conflicting in the Add-On list.

Now stuck in the aftermath, among the refuse and broken dreams, the survivors need to traverse this place of lost trains of thought and escape from the nothingness between existence and purpose... no matter the cost.

---
[h1]QUICK FAQ![/h1]

[h3]Q: Why can't I shoot the things I need to shoot with the mounted gun? It doesn't work![/h3]
A: Every single thing that needs the mounted gun to shoot works on a two fold system. It has a damage filter to only accept bullets, and also needs to pass a damage threshold of 40 points of damage in a single bullet. This will disallow "most" guns with some exceptions, except the mounted gun.
IF YOUR MOUNTED GUN IS NOT BREAK ANYTHING IT NEEDS TO, then you have a mod that is affect the DPS of the mounted gun somewhere. Sometimes it can be obvious, sometimes it can be a modded campaign that is affecting all guns, sometimes it can be something you wouldn't think, like a mod to increase the common amounts because deep in there it also has a script that changes the mounted gun.

If you are experiencing this issue, first check the discussion on this mod documenting mods that are confirmed incompatible. If you find nothing familiar in that list, you need to start disabling addons until it works. This is not something I can account for unless someone can write a script for me that filters all damage except for mounted guns, or named mounted guns. Unless or until someone can do me that solid, or if I find a work around... fixing these rare cases is on your end. I know of a handful of mods that conflicts, but if you find specific ones let me know so I can document it.


[h3]Q: Why is every horde infinite?[/h3]
A: When I took a break from L4D2 for 7 years, I spent most of that time playing other coop horde shooters, one of my favourites being Darktide. I like how most events in that game are "It won't stop till you do that task it is asking" and found it really fun, and I wanted to ty and emulate that here~
The events for Ch2 and Ch4 do end once you have do the last of the tasks, and while it doesn't technically end in Ch1, it does stop new SI from spawning and cut the commons in half once the bridge is in place. I know the two games are different, and endless hordes are harder here than there, but I am doing my best to get that feeling while still trying to balance around this game. If you have critics I do listen and I do take it into account~


[h3]Q: Is it complete?[/h3]
A: Not yet. I did a public alpha to hold myself accountable to actually finish it instead of adding another project to the pile of abandoned projects I have. Once the title has "Beta" instead of "Alpha" it will at the very least be completable with credits roll. Once we hit "Complete" or "Final" then the campaign will be finished with bug fixes as the exception.


[h3]Q: Is there a reason to go after the secrets that I found/Saw in a video of someone else doing?[/h3]
A: The smaller ones yes, since you get more supplies~ 
The bigger ones that are building up to a code? Not yet, but I will be building the reward for that once we get to Ch6. Either a side path in CH6, or as a survival map that you have to have the code for to actually get into... But yeah, not yet~


[h3]Q: The bots suck[/h3]
A: Navigation is hard on solid ground. I am still working on improving it, it will take some time to refine the nav mesh...


[h3]Q: Are there plans on Versus Support[/h3]
A: Don't lie, none of you are asking that... but yes I am planning it~

[h3]Q: When are you done?/Are you going to finish it?[/h3]
A: I work two full time jobs supporting my family, I get about two days a week on average to work on this.
I am a solo dev, and I am keeping it that way... It is going to take me time to finish this, but I am committed to finishing it~
Give me the time and patience to complete it and to do it right, and I will not only give you a once of a kind experience!~
Art take time... Interactive art take much more time... Patience is all I ask my friends~
---


This was originally made as a collab with another friend, two maps, two weeks, no communication with one agreed upon theme... but because I grew attached to this idea, I decided to run with it and see where I can take this bizarre concept~

This is very early in development, if you find bugs or have feedback, there is a discussion board on this mod or make your own... I ask and encourage all feedback~

I am trying to do something truly unique with the campaign, something you have never seen in other campaigns, so this kind of gameplay is uncharted in this game. If you really do hate it, believe it or not I do want to know, because "Standing Gauntlet" are a new type of event in this game in particular, and I do want to keep tweaking the numbers or bring down necessary sledge hammers till this is fun for majority of players~


I came out of retirement to make one more campaign... I want this to be the culmination of my time in this game and in the mapping scene for l4d2... 
This game has been an obsession of my since L4D1. I have seen the and lived through the golden age, seeing new incredbile campaigns posted on L4D2maps. I have seen when campaigns were teased, the work in progress flow and the rather common death of maps shared to quickly: Last Bastion, From Palms to Bombs, Life's a Beach. I was there to see the steady decline of campaigns, and the surgence from different cultures: like when "somefun" "greybox" and the first "hehe4" campaign came out. 
And even own campaigns and failures. I have 7 maps publicly available on the workshop. If you count Gamemaps, that is now 8, if you count mediafire links from 3rd party websites of review blogs, that is now 9, if you can somehow get dead links to work again on old forums, that is now 12... If you count the campaigns that were worked on enough to have a name a tag line? 29 maps. I love doing this, I love making maps. I love doing this.

This campaign is going to be a final capstone to my life. Where I can finally move on, no more looking back with regret and longing. And I would love for anyone and everyone to be able to join me on this ride and shape it be perfect~

This script adds a simple recoil mechanic to all guns in the game.

It's an improvement compared to scripts that use the recoil CVar to add recoil. In those cases, your aim is adjusted to a random spot near where you're already aiming. This results in your aim mostly staying in the same area.

With simple recoil, your aim always moves upwards, forcing you to adjust your aim as you fire. Your gun will also drift to the side and change direction occasionally to add more variability to the spray pattern of each gun.

Additionally, your recoil will be reduced when you're crouching. If you stop firing for a few seconds, your horizontal recoil will be reset.

You can customize the recoil of each gun with the EMS file "simple_recoil/config.txt".
